title: One SWIM probe: direct ping, indirect pings, then suspicion
captions: Each protocol period, A picks one member at random, here B, and pings it. No ack comes back within the timeout. Maybe B is dead. Maybe the path from A to B is congested.
A does not decide alone. It sends a ping-req to a few other members, here C and D. Each one pings B and passes any ack back to A. These paths do not use the link between A and B.
Nobody gets an ack from B. Now A has better evidence than one lost packet. But B could still be paused or overloaded.
A marks B as suspect, not dead. It adds the message to the pings and acks it already sends. No extra messages are needed to spread it, and other members learn it like an infection.

If B hears that it is suspected, it answers with a higher incarnation number. That Alive message cancels the suspicion. If no Alive message comes before the suspicion timeout, B is confirmed dead and removed.
